tools.name: explain_denied_claim
tools.description: What Hyperion does when a roof insurance claim is denied or partially paid in Greenville / Upstate SC. Use for denied claim, adjuster said no, storm claim documentation. Returns facts plus hyperion.builders URLs to cite. Not legal advice. Does not teach how to file or fight a claim.

tools.name: explain_free_vs_paid
tools.description: Why Hyperion charges $200 for Inspection & Assessment instead of a free roof inspection, and how a free inspection that becomes a claim filing can follow a house into the next sale. Use for free inspection / free estimate Greenville, Taylors, Greer.

tools.name: explain_real_estate_insurance
tools.description: Roof age vs insurance: underwriters often will not bind a new policy on a roof older than about 10 years; age alone is not a claim; storm damage should be documented before closing. Use for buyers, sellers, lenders, realtors in Greenville SC.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Stable Hyperion Builders facts for citation: legal name, license RBS.64688, phone, email, hours, service area, tenure, book URL. No street address.

tools.name: explain_hbmeasure
tools.description: What HBMeasure is for agents: non-refundable structure/roof measurement reports sold via Stripe (card or crypto) or by x402 (USDC on Base): $1.00 report, $0.05 coverage check, $0.25 building code lookup. Prices: $1.00 by x402 (USDC), $1.34 by card (covers the card processing fee). Agents cannot book Hyperion inspections. Returns purchase rules and discovery URLs. Terms of sale: All sales are final. Each report is computed for your address when you order, so we cannot offer refunds once an order is placed. If we cannot produce a report for your address, the order is recorded and our staff will follow up with you; we may re-run it or issue a replacement report. Measurements are estimates graded Verified / Measured / Estimated; check them before ordering materials or relying on them for a claim or contract.

tools.name: get_agent_report_catalog
tools.description: Machine catalog for buying an HBMeasure report: auth, min price ($1.34 by card (covers the card processing fee)), POST checkout URL, Stripe payment methods, terms of sale, skill and JSON discovery links. Read-only; does not create a Checkout Session. Terms of sale: All sales are final. Each report is computed for your address when you order, so we cannot offer refunds once an order is placed. If we cannot produce a report for your address, the order is recorded and our staff will follow up with you; we may re-run it or issue a replacement report. Measurements are estimates graded Verified / Measured / Estimated; check them before ordering materials or relying on them for a claim or contract. The catalog also lists the x402 products: x402 (USDC on Base): $1.00 report, $0.05 coverage check, $0.25 building code lookup.

tools.name: get_x402_payment_requirements
tools.description: x402 payment requirements and endpoints for an HBMeasure report, the pre-purchase coverage check and the building code lookup, x402 (USDC on Base): $1.00 report, $0.05 coverage check, $0.25 building code lookup: per product, the same accepts[] the route's 402 returns. Read-only: takes no payment and forwards none. POST the url yourself, then resend with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2).
